method: Human source inspection; expectations are recorded separately from observed analyzer output. A sampled file may exercise only some features.

clojure-0.notes: Leiningen defproject configuration, not a function definition. Preserve dependency configuration as source; caller/type support is not established by this file.

clojure-1.notes: Manual review also found defmethod print-method and Java :import forms. Reader quoting, metadata, regexes, custom tagged values and macro calls need explicit coverage.

clojure-2.notes: Aliased namespace calls, reify protocol implementations and anonymous listener closures; exact runtime dispatch is not statically proven.

perl-0.notes: The upstream fixture is intentionally malformed: sub foo opens at line 4 and never closes. A parse gap is expected, not a valid-source parser regression.

perl-1.notes: Named subroutines and local module imports should work; arrow dispatch, anonymous callbacks and Moose-style generated accessors remain dynamic. Reviewed executable source before POD documentation.

perl-2.notes: POD examples after line 120 are documentation and must not contribute calls or imports. Dynamic callback/arrow dispatch remains inferred.

sql-0.notes: Two-line psql client guard using backslash echo/quit, not plain SQL. Do not invent ALTER EXTENSION declarations from a quoted message.

sql-1.notes: Valid PostgreSQL expressions include :: casts and custom <->, <#>, <=> and <+> operators. Invalid sparse-vector literal values are runtime test inputs, not SQL syntax errors.

sql-2.notes: Another randomly selected psql client guard. Kept unchanged rather than redrawing a DDL-rich file.

css-0.notes: A selector refers to same-file @keyframes rubberBand. Full source must preserve the keyframe body; keyframes need separate indexing for a complete map. Calls/types in the programming-language sense are not applicable.

css-1.notes: Same-file @keyframes backOutRight with percentage steps and CSS transform functions. Check selector, source preservation and map limitation; programming-language callers/types are not applicable.

css-2.notes: @keyframes slideOutDown uses from/to blocks and translate3d percentages. Both animation and selector must remain available as source.

rust-0.notes: Nested repeated MyFuture structs, async blocks, impl methods, cfg attributes and task_local macros. Macro-generated KEY/REQ_ID members and active cfg conditions are not compiler-resolved.

rust-1.notes: Two-line cfg(loom) module declaration. A forward file graph should expose the local mod file as a conditional/static dependency, not claim an unconditional runtime import.

rust-2.notes: Re-exports, generic where clauses, crate-private methods, unsafe trait impls and std/backtrace types. Reviewed declaration/import windows and representative method bodies.

python-0.notes: Relative imports inside functions, TYPE_CHECKING imports, aliases, nested generator functions, union/generic annotations and Jinja inheritance. Template names and dynamic loader dispatch require runtime knowledge.

python-1.notes: Properties, classmethods, positional-only arguments, annotated attributes, nested closures, walrus expressions, docstring code examples and dynamic module __getattr__. Docstring examples must not become declarations/imports.

python-2.notes: Nested classes, parametrized decorators, f-strings and config loading from Python/JSON/TOML or environment variables; runtime configuration filenames are not statically executed.

javascript-0.notes: CommonJS modules, prototype function assignments, chained aliases and getter callbacks. Public request methods should be visible without treating JSDoc examples as code.

javascript-1.notes: CommonJS directory import, local user module, nested callbacks and route middleware references. Block-commented routes must not create calls or contract relationships.

javascript-2.notes: Anonymous functions assigned to object properties, duplicate list/delete names on distinct objects, recursive app.map and dynamic app[key] dispatch. Names alone cannot prove bindings.

typescript-0.notes: Typed arrow variable, nested function, import type, namespace imports, Unicode strings and .js specifiers targeting .ts source. Default anonymous exports may have no stable function name.

typescript-1.notes: TSX, async default export, path aliases, bracketed Next.js route directories, type casts, optional chaining and JSX callbacks. tsconfig alias resolution and JSX dispatch need explicit limitations.

typescript-2.notes: Tests are anonymous callbacks and need whole-file fallback when no named declaration is extracted. Chained calls, Unicode messages and multi-line receivers must parse.

go-0.notes: Method receivers, local structs, composite literals, same-package Error/H definitions and imported packages. Same-package bindings and build tags need verification independently of explicit imports.

go-1.notes: sync.OnceValue function-valued global, variadic wrappers and aliased package-qualified return types. Importing gin should include its package source; exact method dispatch remains approximate.

go-2.notes: No explicit imports, but mapURI and validate live in sibling files of the same Go package. A file-only dependency view must acknowledge or include this implicit package context.

swift-0.notes: RawRepresentable struct with static constants, stored rawValue and init. Fields/initializer must survive full source selection. Combined expansion exceeded 90 seconds on the first run.

swift-1.notes: @testable import, @unchecked Sendable, @MainActor, nested subclasses, overrides, implicit-member enum values and trailing closures. Local target membership and imported SDK types are distinct.

swift-2.notes: Generic struct, associatedtype protocol and extension accessors with get/set. Generic parameters should not be mistaken for missing concrete files.

java-0.notes: Annotations refer to local same-package and nested imported fixture types under src/testFixtures/java. Combined expansion exceeded 90 seconds on the first run.

java-1.notes: Many overloaded methods, private constructor, static imports and type-use @Nullable inside generics. Callers must remain inferred when overload binding is unknown.

java-2.notes: A Java annotation declaration uses @interface, not a normal interface node. Javadoc contains annotation names but is not executable source.

c-0.notes: Static functions, C struct fields/pointer parameters and include-defined typedefs/macros. Header reachability is statically local; preprocessor configurations are not evaluated.

c-1.notes: Redis module API function pointers, callback registration and builtin casts. Callback bindings are not ordinary direct-call relationships.

c-2.notes: Random draw selected bundled hiredis source; this was retained. Static prototypes/definitions, function-like macros and ownership callbacks require careful inferred binding.

cpp-0.notes: Out-of-line constructor/destructor, noexcept, qualified names, exception handling and a preprocessor-controlled region.

cpp-1.notes: Both test bodies are generated by the TEST macro. Compiler-equivalent function identities require macro expansion; a static source map must retain the macro bodies and disclose the limitation.

cpp-2.notes: This .h is C++, using templates, member pointers, trailing return types, namespaces, macro namespace wrappers and platform conditionals. A recoverable parse gap from unexpanded macro wrappers is a limitation, not evidence the source is invalid C++.

csharp-0.notes: Global using-only file. Preserve it as source and namespace context; no function/type declarations are expected in this file.

csharp-1.notes: File-scoped namespace, nullable fields/arguments, constructor initializer, ThreadStatic and FEATURE_SPAN conditional overrides. Global/implicit imports require package context.

csharp-2.notes: Attributes, target-typed new, deeply nested anonymous objects, nullable casts and global using dependencies from another file.

kotlin-0.notes: Default arguments, nested anonymous object overrides, data/sealed/enum classes and imported constants in a multiplatform source root. Both mapping and combined expansion exceeded 90 seconds in the baseline.

kotlin-1.notes: Expression-bodied override with a nullable nested external interface type and annotation.

kotlin-2.notes: Top-level property getter, extension/companion import, vararg function named String and overload ambiguity with the builtin type.

ruby-0.notes: Shoulda block DSL, inheritance, Ruby calls without parentheses, interpolation, block arguments and symlink test code. The audit never executes the fixture filesystem operations.

ruby-1.notes: Nested test DSL blocks, hash arguments, predicate methods and class constructors. Generated test methods are not available without executing the DSL.

ruby-2.notes: Module nesting, inherited Plugin without a require in this file, singleton def self methods and duplicate singleton/instance method names. Autoload dependencies are not equivalent to literal require edges.

php-0.notes: Aliased parent type, PHPDoc templates and Laravel higher-order property proxy calls. Static names cannot establish the dynamically forwarded receiver.

php-1.notes: Builtin exception inheritance, constructor, parent static scope and interpolated strings. The builtin is external, not a missing local class.

php-2.notes: Trait method adaptation, imported functions, union types, magic forwarding, anonymous closures and Composer PSR-4 paths. PHPDoc mixins/runtime macros cannot prove concrete dispatch.

zig-0.notes: Comptime branches, conditional container alias Ctx, duplicate method names, function-pointer vtables, extern prototypes/structs and std-qualified types. Named options/Tracy C bindings are build-provided; do not resolve them by filename guess.

zig-1.notes: ZLS semantic fixture uses addrspace, linksection, callconv, type-valued function and undefined member access. The latter is a deliberate semantic unknown, not malformed syntax.

zig-2.notes: Error unions, sentinel strings, inline test declaration, builtin types, pointer captures and quoted enum tags. Named zls is a build module and remains a gap; current models need that uncertainty.

bash-0.notes: Parameter expansion, command substitution, Unicode prompt strings and function registration. No literal source import exists; shell framework autoloading is outside literal loader resolution.

bash-1.notes: Hyphenated function names and alias strings. An awkward test expression can fail at runtime while still being valid Bash syntax; aliases must not be parsed as executable calls from their quoted values.

bash-2.notes: Unparenthesized function syntax, command prefixes, arrays/brace expansion, nested substitutions and aliases containing commands. Framework _omb_module_require completion:git is not a literal source statement and needs explicit limitation.

dart-0.notes: Named nullable callback parameters, nested functions, generic streams, cascade syntax, closures and an unnamed extension method. SDK/meta imports are external; local relatives must resolve.

dart-1.notes: A monorepo package under dio/, package: imports, generated mock import, async nested test callbacks and generic isA. Root-level pubspec alone is insufficient for workspace package binding.

dart-2.notes: Generic function bounds, nullable values, type tests, named constructor calls and cascade invocations. A generic parameter S is not an unresolved local source type.

lua-0.notes: Immediately-called require result, destructured local aliases and Lua long strings containing Vimscript. Embedded Vimscript must not become Lua symbols/imports.

lua-1.notes: Local functions including one nested in an anonymous test callback, aliased test functions and multi-level API fields. Calls can be indexed while dynamic receiver binding remains uncertain.

lua-2.notes: Generic for iterator calls, dotted vim.fs APIs, nested anonymous setup/teardown functions and long-bracket string fixtures; no upstream filesystem code is executed.

scala-0.notes: Higher-kinded types, implicit parameters, wildcard and selector imports, nested expression-bodied methods and typeclass extension syntax. Local Cats sources live in component source roots, beyond a flat root/src assumption.

scala-1.notes: Scalafix output fixture uses older wildcard syntax, nested case classes, curried calls and implicit extension methods; exact typeclass dispatch remains uncertain.

scala-2.notes: Historical Scalafix input refers to an old Cats API, so a missing current Cartesian definition is not automatically a resolver bug. Context bounds and higher-kinded function signatures still need preservation.

elixir-0.notes: use/describe/test macros, sigils and heredoc containing generated router code. String contents must not become actual module or handler definitions.

elixir-1.notes: Private definitions, guard clauses, multiple heads, pipelines, captures, specs, dynamic module calls and regex sigils. Multiple same-name clauses require distinct source identities.

elixir-2.notes: Code.require_file relative to __DIR__, alias prefixes, generated-module snippets inside sigils and ExUnit macros. Do not turn the asserted source strings into live declarations.

r-0.notes: Anonymous test blocks, named arguments and snapshot macros. No explicit source/library loader; package-level NAMESPACE/global function bindings require broader R package knowledge.

r-1.notes: Native pipe, captured expressions, function-valued arguments and tidy evaluation. Calls are present even though there are no named function declarations.

r-2.notes: S3 generics/methods, namespace operator, dotted identifiers, nonstandard evaluation and roxygen examples. Runtime S3 dispatch and package NAMESPACE imports are unverified.

julia-0.notes: Repeated local short-form loss definitions inside testset macros, Unicode identifiers, do blocks, comprehensions and mutating calls. Reactant code is inspected only; no GPU training runs.

julia-1.notes: using imports, selective import after colon, constructors, named keyword arguments and let-bound execution code. External package sources are not fetched; local Flux module should be distinguished where possible.

julia-2.notes: quote-generated Base.show methods, interpolation, overloaded long/short functions, callable pipelines and a large multiline block comment. Quoted definitions are templates rather than proven live runtime methods.

haskell-0.notes: CPP branches, language pragmas, separate type signature, where-bound helpers, qualified operator imports and re-exports. Both branches are static candidates, not simultaneous compiler-selected implementations.

haskell-1.notes: Separate signatures and ordinary curried application should be represented; large string-list values are not functions. Constant pattern bindings need preservation as file context.

haskell-2.notes: Qualified aliases, point-free bindings, record updates, do notation, <$> and >>=. A map should retain the separate type signature, while overload/typeclass dispatch remains uncertain.

powershell-0.notes: UTF-8 BOM, comment-based help, attributes, parameter pipeline binding, typed static method call and object methods. Help examples are not executable calls.

powershell-1.notes: UTF-8 BOM, two hyphenated command definitions, switches, static/object methods, casts and case-sensitive regex operators. Command extraction alone does not establish method-call coverage.

powershell-2.notes: UTF-8 BOM, nested Pester scriptblocks, pipeline commands, scriptblock literals and escaped single-quoted messages. Test DSL blocks are not ordinary named functions.

hcl-0.notes: More than 100 output blocks reference a sibling module.vpc declaration. Terraform files in the directory should share scope; default snippet limits must report omissions without splitting blocks.

hcl-1.notes: Variable blocks with type=any/default={} and wrapper sibling module scope. HCL provider evaluation and generated resource graphs are outside local source resolution.

hcl-2.notes: Nested configuration block contains a registry provider address, not a local file import. Provider source should not be read or executed.

html-0.notes: defer script dependency, inline style, a paragraph ID and self-closing image ID. Navigation hrefs and image resources are not executable script/style imports; check ID extraction for void elements.

html-1.notes: Relative stylesheet and deferred script; buttons use classes rather than IDs and text mentions scroll methods. Rendered prose must not become JavaScript calls or named declarations.

html-2.notes: Navigation ID and stylesheet. Sibling page links are navigation, not automatic module dependencies. No inline JavaScript or programming-language types/callers are present.
